thread.title: I Want to Love You Till Your Dying Day • Kimi ga Shinu made Koi wo Shitai - Episode 13 discussion - FINAL

opinions.point: Several viewers found the emotional character focus effective and praised the series’ handling of inner conflict and grief.
Some commenters considered the show a strong overall experience, highlighting its characters, relationships, voice acting, music, and emotional impact.
A few viewers felt the finale was structurally unusual or anticlimactic because it focused heavily on one character while giving the central pair limited presence.
Multiple commenters enjoyed the finale’s quieter, more reflective tone and felt it provided meaningful emotional progress.
Some viewers wanted another season because they felt the broader setting and several character or world questions remained unresolved.
Many comments were frustrated that English subtitles were unavailable on time, significantly hindering the viewing experience.
